perf.summary: Avoid re-indexing offsets[levelStart + i] / sizes[levelStart + i] multiple times per node.
perf.currentCost: In the paired branch, offsets[levelStart + i] and offsets[levelStart + i + 1] are read for the ToomCook pointer args while sizes are read separately into sa/sb; in the odd branch offsets[levelStart+i] and sizes[levelStart+i] are each indexed once. The levelStart+i address arithmetic is recomputed for each separate array access.
perf.proposedChange: Hoist the base index once: int li = levelStart + i; then use offsets[li], offsets[li+1], sizes[li], sizes[li+1]. Load offsets[li]/offsets[li+1] into locals oa, ob and pass tree + oa, tree + ob to ToomCook.
perf.rationale: Removes redundant integer add for the base index and lets the compiler keep the offsets in registers across the multiply-arg setup; fewer reloads from the offsets/sizes arrays.
perf.risk: None; pure CSE of index arithmetic, identical semantics.

perf.summary: Strength-reduce the i*2 indexing in the leaf-initialization loop to an additive stride.
perf.currentCost: The leaf loop computes i*2 three times per iteration (offsets[nodeCount]=i*2, tree[i*2], tree[i*2+1]). i*2 is a shift but it is recomputed and the two tree writes index i*2 and i*2+1 separately.
perf.proposedChange: Maintain int two_i = 0; incrementing two_i += 2 each iteration; use offsets[i] = two_i; tree[two_i] = (MOD - values[i] % MOD) % MOD; tree[two_i + 1] = 1; (nodeCount == i here so use i directly for offsets/sizes index).
perf.rationale: Replaces repeated multiply/shift with a single add per iteration and makes the two adjacent tree stores share a base pointer, friendlier to write-combining. nodeCount equals i throughout this loop so it can be dropped in favor of i, removing an increment.
perf.risk: nodeCount must still end at n for the subsequent level loop; setting nodeCount = n after the loop preserves that. Semantics identical. The (MOD - values[i]%MOD)%MOD already correctly handles values[i] in [0,MOD) producing the monic linear factor's constant term; unchanged.
